description: Retry and resilience rules for test execution and JIRA operations.

testExecution.retryReason: Transient CDN/WAF 403 errors from cloud datacenter IPs
testExecution.flakyDetection: Test that passes on retry is marked flaky, not passed

onDoubleFailure.action: Do NOT fabricate keys/transitions. Record 'JIRA pending' in the skill's own output artifact.
onDoubleFailure.notify: Inform user of JIRA connectivity issue

jira.healthCheck: Make lightweight getJiraIssue call before batched operations

_note: No gitClone block: the execution skill runs the LOCAL unified regression-suite via hyperexecute.exe. It never clones a git repo. Generated code lives at qe-pipeline/output/regression-suite/. (Git push of generated scripts, if ever enabled, is a separate concern under pipeline-config.json → gitlab.scriptRepo, not an execution retry path.)
